name: Grilled lake shrimp
summary: Lake shrimp grilled beside the fish until both turn golden.
origin: The lake table. Thái Nguyên, 1 April 2026.
howToEat: Thái Nguyên grills the shrimp with the fish. When the shrimp and the fish turn golden, they are ready.
